class.name: CSGInstance3D
class.brief_description: An editable mesh backed by CSG shapes, combined and ready for blockouts.
class.description: [CSGInstance3D] is a [MeshInstance3D] backed by editable CSG shapes (e.g. [CSGBox3D], [CSGCombiner3D], etc). In edit mode you can add and edit CSG shapes directly; leaving edit mode bakes them into this node's mesh. CSG shapes on their own can't receive baked lighting. Baking them into a real mesh unlocks static lighting with [LightmapGI], while also improving performance and compatibility with other nodes.

method.name: is_edit_mode
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the node is currently in edit mode.

method.name: rebuild_mesh
method.description: Rebuilds the baked mesh, including lightmap UV2.

members.member: Texel size used when generating lightmap UV2, in the same units as [method ArrayMesh.lightmap_unwrap].
